title: QA run · smoke:npm-18.0.0 (27/27) · 06cab484 · 2026-10-20 · 22 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 5 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
Post-release smoke of the PUBLISHED 18.0.0 (npm), real user paths. Ordered by the dispatch session session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi (maintainer-approved, 2026-10-20) under release-aftercare.md B. Anchor: #24579.

ENVIRONMENT
- Subject: @objectstack/cli@18.0.0 and create-objectstack@18.0.0 from npm (dist-tag latest = 18.0.0, published 2026-10-20 12:44 UTC). Every package under test was installed from the registry into /home/user/smoke, outside the repo. No workspace build, no link:.
- Source checkout used only for reading code and docs: framework 06cab4849a (the 18.0.0 version-tag commit).
- Node v22.22.0, npm 10.9.4, pnpm 10.28.0. PostgreSQL 16.15 (local, port 55432). SQLite via better-sqlite3.
- Ports 3000, 3101-3103, 3201-3203, 3301-3302, 3401-3404. One file DB per cell under /home/user/smoke. Servers started with setsid and stopped by the listener's process group; port release confirmed each time.
- Run executed sequentially by one agent (no sub-agents). 2026-10-20 13:30-13:55 UTC.

SCOPE
- Selector smoke:npm-18.0.0 is a dispatched smoke, not a checklist selector: 27 cells across A-E as listed in the dispatch. No checklist item revision applies. No planned items.

A. NEW USER ONBOARDING (docs: getting-started/index.mdx, your-first-project.mdx, quick-start.mdx)
A1 PASS. npm create objectstack@18.0.0 my-app -- --skip-skills: exit 0, 16 s, "Create ObjectStack v18.0.0", installed with pnpm; cli/spec/runtime resolve 18.0.0.
A2 PASS. npx -y create-objectstack my-app --skip-skills (the index.mdx spelling, resolves latest): exit 0, v18.0.0.
A3 PASS. The same with pnpm removed from PATH (npm 10.9.4 only): exit 0, npm installed, npx os validate passes. Note: index.mdx says "npm 10 cannot install the CLI right now" (edgesOut). Not reproduced for the scaffold, because the template's package.json already carries overrides vitest ~4.0.0 (troubleshooting.mdx fix 2). Not filed: only npm 10.9.4 measured, and npm install -g was not tried.
A4 PASS. npx os validate: exit 0, "Validation passed", 1 object, 2 fields, 0 apps.
A5 PASS. npx os dev --ui: "Server is ready" on 3000, dev admin admin@objectos.ai / admin123 seeded, 42 plugins.
A6 PASS. GET /api/v1/discovery 200.
A7 PASS. GET /_console/ 200 text/html, 18301 bytes, div id=root; GET /_console/assets/index-BQWjE1TW.js 200 application/javascript, 311549 bytes.
A8 PASS. POST /api/v1/auth/sign-up/email 403 SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED (invite_only). Docs path: sign in as the seeded dev admin, POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email 200.
A9 PASS. Docs CRUD verbatim: POST /api/v1/data/my_app_note 201; GET ?select=title&sort=-created_at&top=10 200 (total 1); GET by id 200; PATCH 200 (updated_at moved); DELETE 200 success true; GET 404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND.

B. PRODUCTION DEPLOY PATH (scaffolded app, OS_AUTH_SECRET and OS_SECRET_KEY set, fresh SQLite file)
B1 FAIL (#24827 reproduces on the published package, blank scaffold). os build exit 0. OS_DATABASE_URL=file:FRESH os migrate apply --yes: exit 0; sys_migration has 0 rows. os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json --port 3101: exit 1, "This database carries no organization-ownership marker: 17.x or an 18.0 pre-release (18.0.0-next.*) created it ... Run 'os migrate organization-ownership --out PLAN' ...". The refusal is printed three times, twice with a full stack trace, before the one-line summary.
B2 PASS (workaround 1, on B1's refused file). os migrate organization-ownership --out plan.json exit 0 ("76 table(s) planned"); --apply --plan-file plan.json --backup-taken exit 0 ("The ceremony is complete; recorded as adr-0131-organization-ownership"); os start: "Server is ready"; first-account sign-up 200; sign-in 200; create and list 200; second sign-up 403.
B3 PASS (workaround 2, and the reversed order). Fresh file: os start (up), stop, os migrate apply --yes exit 0 ("already in sync"), os start: "Server is ready"; first-admin sign-up, sign-in and CRUD as in B2.
B4 PASS. Production first admin (self-hosting.mdx "First boot"): on an empty production DB the first sign-up is admitted, and the next one is refused 403.

C. UPGRADE PATHS (published packages)
C1 PASS. 17.7.0 app (create-objectstack@17.7.0), os dev on a file DB. Written over HTTP: an admin-created user (POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user), an app17_note record, and branding.workspace_name = "Smoke v17" (PUT /api/settings/branding). Then the upgrading.mdx steps: every @objectstack dependency to 18.0.0, pnpm install, specVersion ^18.0.0, engines.protocol ^18, validate and build pass. os start: exit 1, the refusal names the ceremony commands (and lists 9 tables that still carry organization_id).
C2 PASS. Ceremony plan exit 0 (81 tables); apply exit 0 (complete); os start ready. admin@objectos.ai / admin123 200; the created user with its original password 200; the record is readable with organization_id stamped; the setting reads "Smoke v17" (tenant); sys_user lists both users.
C3 PASS. os dev over a copy of the 17.7.0 DB auto-upgrades in place and keeps a backup; logins and data as in C2. It first logs ERROR with the full stack of the boot refusal (the noise #24833 already tracks).
C4 PASS. 18.0.0-next.5 app (exact 18.0.0-next.5 pins; the main tree resolved at next.5, 16 leaf packages pulled at 18.0.0 by ranges): the same writes; then bump to 18.0.0; os start refused; plan, apply, start; logins, record and setting all read back.
C5 PASS. Identity mail moved. On next.5, POST /api/v1/auth/request-password-reset 200 wrote sys_email "Reset your Smoke n5 password" (related_object sys_user). An organization invite wrote sys_email "Dev Admin invited you..." (sys_invitation). After the ceremony, sys_identity_email holds the reset mail (the table has no organization_id column) and sys_email keeps only the invitation.
C6 FAIL (docs). upgrading.mdx's per-release table starts at v17.4.0, with no 17.5-17.7 or 18.0.0 row, and neither upgrading.mdx nor releases/v18/index.mdx mentions os migrate organization-ownership. The only thing that leads an operator to the ceremony is the refusal text. Already tracked: #24904, #24905 (no new card).

D. DRIVER DIFFERENCES (PostgreSQL 16.15 local)
D1 FAIL (new card). A scaffolded app pointed at Postgres as your-first-project.mdx says (os dev -d postgres://...) is refused: "datasource 'default': connect failed ... Cannot find module 'pg' ... The driver package could not be LOADED at all ... That is a build precondition, not a datasource fault ... Run pnpm install && pnpm build, then start again." Ran exactly that in a second scaffold: pnpm install exit 0, pnpm build exit 0, then os dev refused again with the same text. The fix is pnpm add pg (drivers.mdx and self-hosting.mdx say so).
D2 PASS. After pnpm add pg: Driver SqlDriver(pg); discovery 200, console 200, sign-in 200, and the A9 CRUD sequence all green (201/200/200/200/200/404).
D3 FAIL (#24835 reproduces on the published package). The scaffold with a declared webhook on my_app_note (create/update/delete) and requires automation, triggers, webhooks, realtime, on a fresh PG DB: activation POST /api/v1/security/_activation/webhook/my_app_note_changed 200 enabled true; the create enqueued one sys_http_delivery row (declared:my_app_note_changed, pending); the PATCH answered 200 and enqueued nothing. Log: WARN [webhook-auto-enqueuer] enqueue failed ... "Converting circular structure to JSON --> starting at object with constructor 'Timeout'". The same app on SQLite: 2 rows (create and update).
D4 PASS. Webhook on SQLite as in D3: 2 delivery rows.

E. OFF-LIST PROBES (RUNNER rule 8)
E1 PASS. os doctor exit 0: all green, one warning, "Object my_app_note is defined but not referenced by any view, flow, app, or lookup field".
E2 PASS. Bare npx os prints the help, exit 0. Observation: several TOPICS lines carry one subcommand's description instead of the topic's (data "Create a new record", meta "Delete a metadata item", db "Reclaim SQLite free space ..."). Not filed.
E3 PASS. 71 command files in the package versus the docs: every top-level command the docs name exists, except the generated reference references/marketplace/marketplace.mdx (from packages/spec/src/marketplace/marketplace.zod.ts:27), which says "os projects bind"; the CLI has os environments bind. Not filed (one stale line in a generated reference).
E4 PASS. Package contents: @objectstack/console@18.0.0 ships dist (42 MB), and /_console/ serves it (A7).
E5 FAIL (new card). A declared webhook in a scaffold is silently inert. With webhooks: [...] and no 'webhooks' in requires, os validate passes and the boot prints nothing about it; activation answers 503 "no declared-webhook reader is bound". With 'webhooks' but no 'realtime', activation answers 200 enabled true, record writes answer 200, and no delivery is ever enqueued; the only trace is WARN "[webhook-auto-enqueuer] disabled — ObjectQL, Realtime, or Messaging service not available". automation/webhooks.mdx names neither capability.

UX observation (not filed): the blank scaffold declares no app, so the Console home shows "Your apps 0" and the Notes object is reachable only by typing /_console/apps/com.objectstack.setup/my_app_note. your-first-project.mdx sends the reader to the Console to "create a record".

FAIL REPRODUCTION RULES
- B1: npm create objectstack@18.0.0 my-app; cd my-app; npx os build; export OS_AUTH_SECRET=(32+ chars) OS_SECRET_KEY=(64 hex) OS_DATABASE_URL=file:/tmp/x/prod.db; npx os migrate apply --yes; npx os start --artifact ./dist/objectstack.json --port 3101. Expected: listening. Actual: exit 1 with the ownership-marker refusal.
- C6: read content/docs/upgrading.mdx "Per-release specifics" and content/docs/releases/v18/index.mdx. Expected: a v18.0.0 row and the ceremony sequence. Actual: neither.
- D1: in a fresh scaffold, npx os dev --no-watch -p 3404 -d postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/db. Expected: either boot, or a remedy that works (pnpm add pg). Actual: refused, told to run pnpm install && pnpm build, which leaves it refused.
- D3: scaffold plus defineWebhook on my_app_note (isActive true) plus requires automation, triggers, webhooks, realtime; pnpm add pg; os dev on PG; activate; create a note, then PATCH it. Expected: 2 sys_http_delivery rows. Actual: 1, and a WARN enqueue failed (circular Timeout).
- E5: scaffold plus webhooks: [defineWebhook(...)], with requires left as scaffolded; os validate (passes); os dev; POST /api/v1/security/_activation/webhook/NAME {"enabled":true}. Expected: a refusal at validate or boot naming the missing capability. Actual: 503 at activation. Add 'webhooks' only: activation 200, deliveries 0, one WARN at boot.

DISPOSITION OF FAILS
- B1: product defect, existing #24827 (comment with workarounds).
- C6: product docs defect, existing #24904 / #24905.
- D1: product defect, new card.
- D3: product defect, existing #24835 (comment).
- E5: product defect, new card.

Fixture gaps: none. The showcase app is not on npm, so D3, D4 and E5 used a declared webhook in the scaffold instead of showcase_task_changed.
